resolution.note: verify removes only dirs of units graded and dropped in this run; all-install-fail exits 75 naming infrastructure; CLI test through real verify

title: Screening verify keeps unit directories when every grade fails install
body:
screening verify deletes a unit directory on any drop (evals/units/screening.ts, "A dropped unit leaves the unit set"). With a relative --scratch (fixed in t-xasrw18) every grade failed with install 1 and two committed units were removed from the worktree. A run where every graded unit fails install is an infrastructure failure, not a unit verdict.
Acceptance: a verify run where every graded unit fails install keeps the unit directories and exits non-zero naming infrastructure.
Proof: node --test test/evals/screening-units.test.ts exits 0 with an all-install-fail test
